lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns along the mid-to-posterior flank, with decreasing inter-centroid spatial frequency towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with circular nodes in the mid-flank region, forming a grid-like topology where the nodes represent local intensity maxima.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots, primarily concentrated on the lower and anterior portions of the visible fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Reticulated, non-circular patterns of high-luminance pixels are located in the anterior section of the flank, where vertical stripes exhibit bifurcation and complex branching.
